title: Use CSV staging tables for high-volume generated object loads
problem: Per-row SQL is reviewable but too large for hundred-thousand or million-object batches.
recommended_pattern: Export validated JSONL shards into table-shaped CSV files, load them with psql \copy into temporary staging tables, then upsert into canonical Postgres tables.
quality_gate: Bulk load output includes CSV files, a load.sql script, counts by table, and a follow-up object_count_report.sql run.

title: Load source records, normalized objects, promotion decisions, and index records first
problem: A generated primitive is not useful if it cannot be traced, queried, ranked, or promoted.
recommended_pattern: Prioritize source_record, normalized_object, promotion_decision, and index_record bulk paths before secondary tables.
quality_gate: A large factory batch reports source_record, normalized_object, promotion_decision, and index_record counts separately.

title: Run privacy gates before bulk export
problem: Bulk loaders can rapidly multiply sensitive or unlicensed content if staging gates are skipped.
recommended_pattern: Only bulk-export rows that have passed source governance, privacy screening, dedupe, and review routing rules. Store sensitive rejects as review tickets or excluded audit counts, not published objects.
quality_gate: Bulk load manifest records privacy boundary, input shard paths, and count summaries.
